This service enables eligible individuals to receive expert consultations from a pharmacist for a range of common health conditions, helping to support the ongoing medical needs of the local community.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Cudworth is a long-established urban village situated approximately three miles north-east of Barnsley town centre in South Yorkshire. Historically built around agriculture and pit villages serving the local coal mining industry, the settlement has grown into a substantial residential township featuring a combination of traditional housing, post-war estates, and contemporary developments.

The locality is served by several civic and recreational facilities, including Cudworth Park with its green spaces and play areas, and the Dorothy Hyman Sports Centre, named after the Olympic athlete from the area. Retail needs are met mainly along Barnsley Road and Pontefract Road, which form the primary commercial thoroughfare with a selection of independent shops, supermarkets, and local services. Healthcare provision in the district includes local GP surgeries and health centres that cater to the everyday medical needs of the population.

To support local healthcare access, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from the neighbourhood. Through Pharmacy First, individuals can consult a pharmacist regarding certain common health conditions. The pharmacist undertakes a clinical assessment reviewing symptoms, relevant medicines, and medical history. Based on this individual clinical assessment, the outcome may include practical advice, suitable treatment, or referral to another healthcare professional.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 5.8 km in a straight line from Cudworth.
